files.description: Bike-share riders, one per row (400 rows): rider_id (six-digit id with leading zeros), display_name (person name, some with accented letters), home_district (one of 6 districts such as "Old Town"), membership (casual, monthly or annual) - these three text columns have inconsistent capital letters and stray spaces; joined_on (date as text, YYYY-MM-DD; about 2% empty), birth_year (whole number; about 4% empty), credit_balance (two decimals, can be negative; about 5% empty).

task_text: Cross-tabulate the riders in riders.csv by home_district and membership, both trimmed and lower-cased. `result` should be a table of rider counts with home districts as rows in alphabetical order and membership levels as columns in the order annual, casual, monthly, plus a final row and a final column named total holding the row and column totals.
intended_computation: Read riders.csv; clean home_district and membership (strip, lower case); rider counts with home districts as rows (alphabetical) and membership levels as columns (annual, casual, monthly), plus a last row and a last column named total holding the row totals, the column totals and the grand total (400).
